system.description:
Learn one cantrip and two 1st-level spells from another class's spell list. They count as your class spells and use your casting stat. You can cast each of the two 1st-level spells once a day without expending a slot, or with your slots as normal.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
